notes.title: Help us understand which languages to prioritize for localizing.
notes.content:
[b]Dear friends![/b] ːbirdmaskː

We want more people to experience our creations in their native language. This is why we're asking you to fill out a survey available through this link: https://bit.ly/3RRNjXb
It will help us understand which languages to prioritize for localizing. We promise it won't take long!

[i]P.S.:
A lot of bad things happened during these months, and continue happening right now. In these times we remain friends and continue making games. One of them is a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1913600/_/]continuation of the Sanator story[/url], and the other is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2082000/WORMWOOD/]something completely new.[/url][/i]

notes.title: NEW GAME! Sanator: The Jewel of Monostructure
notes.content:
[b]Hello, dear friends![/b] 

It's us, Ignis Sanat, the "Scarlet Scarf" developers.

This post was supposed to inform you about the release of "Sanator: The Wedding", but we'll be honest with you: the Wedding's release is delayed. We deeply apologize to everyone who expected the project to release by now, but don't be discouraged yet—The Wedding is still being worked on. The game's development is now completely in the hands of the Scarlet Scarf's main writer and the creator of the Domus et Animae universe, Gilbert Brissen, and the art for the game will be provided by a prize-winner from the 14th International Manga award, Natalia Rerekina. Meanwhile, Ignis Sanat will mainly focus on projects of a smaller scale."

[b]Still, there is also some good news.[/b]

Instead of "The Wedding", we'll be bringing you "The Taiga"! Under Gil's supervision, the story for "Sanator: St. Elmo's Legacy" will be created by Pony, the artist for the Scarlet Scarf and a co-author of Chronicles of Reustadt. This story takes place after "The Scarlet Scarf", and we follow Richard as he goes on an expedition to lake Tanaer. Ailur, ancient artifacts, and a conspiracy inside the Brotherhood—all of that awaits you in the game slated for release no earlier than 2023.

As for right now, we're happy to present you another game ins the series—Sanator: The Jewel of Monostructure. It's a small side story and a prequel to The Scarlet Scarf. Nonetheless, The Jewel of Monostructure is a standalone game with a new character (that we'll also see in the St. Elmo's Legacy) and three endings and it's not tied to the epidemic in any way. Richard will need to investigate the case involving a series of mysterious thefts and find out what's hidden in the centuries-old labyrinths under Reustadt. We sincerely hope you'll like it:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1644280/The_Jewel_of_Monostructure/

[b]Thank you for your continuous support. Best wishes, Ignis Sanat[/b]

[i]P.S. More projects to come! After some time we promise to release a series of smaller games in the dark fantasy and horror genres. Pony and Roxygen, who worked on the direction, art direction, programming and even wrote a bit of text related to Krita and her loyal dog are currently hard at work on these projects.[/i]

notes.title: Trading cards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34024430/79b06a58cace7b2b5e88e4e35a71dff64489a85f.png[/img]

We are happy to announce that trading cards are finally available. By creating and leveling up the Scarlet Scarf badge, you can get up to six different profile backgrounds and emojis. Some 
curious details that were not included in the game await you in the cards of Avis, Winfred and Weiger (click "View Badge Progress" and zoom in). 

Exclusive items from the points shop, such as an animated avatar, sticker and frame, are also available now: https://store.steampowered.com/points/shop/app/650330/

As you know, the trading cards on Steam are being allowed when a game achieves certain results. Dear friends, all this became possible only thanks to your support. Thank you very much.

notes.title: Update — English translation improvements and other fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34024430/ce7d5b937cedd97b274abcc7cb7939058a92b772.png[/img]

[b]We are glad to inform you that we've improved the overall game experience based on the community feedback:[/b]

[list]
[*] "Sanator: Chronicles of Reustadt" is now included in the base game (+ one new achievement). 
[*] Improved the English translation with the help of an English native editor. 
[*] Improved the language selection screen.
[*] Fixed the reported bugs and typos.
[/list]

notes.title: Summer fever!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34024430/25c2bf9e2f5358cd3d397b3b0d9475e8a8af5827.png[/img]

During the last three days of the summer sale you can get Sanator: Scarlet Scarf 20% off – for just $7.99.
We've fixed some of the reported issues and made the game more polished overall. The base version now also includes the Chronicles of Reustadt prequel.

[b]P.S.[/b]
We're sincerely grateful to everyone who bought the game at full price. Thank you for having faith in our project and your continued support. We really appreciate it.

notes.title: “Sanator: Scarlet Scarf” is finally available on Steam!
